name: communes
title: Communes
description: The communes and the municipal arrondissements (Paris, Lyon, Marseille), closed ones included.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Stable identifier of the row, never reused. It is the target of the foreign keys of an application.

fields.name: department_id
fields.description: Identifier of the department. Empty for a closed commune whose department no longer exists.

fields.name: insee_code
fields.description: INSEE code of the commune, five characters (2A or 2B for Corsica).

fields.name: kind
fields.description: COM for a commune, ARM for a municipal arrondissement.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Name in lower case without accents, words separated by hyphens.

fields.name: centre_latitude
fields.description: Latitude of the centre of the commune, in decimal degrees (WGS 84).

fields.name: centre_longitude
fields.description: Longitude of the centre of the commune, in decimal degrees (WGS 84).

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: First day of validity of the row (YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Last day of validity of the row (YYYY-MM-DD). Empty while the row is valid: a row is never deleted, its validity is closed.
